launch_scripts.raw_utf8:
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
$toolDir='C:\Users\Zhang\.codex\tmp\nestlink-baseline\58e3948-target-tools\artifact-13211108772-verified'
$outDir='C:\Users\Zhang\.codex\tmp\nestlink-resume-20261103\target-58e3948'
$identity=[Security.Principal.WindowsIdentity]::GetCurrent()
$principal=New-Object Security.Principal.WindowsPrincipal($identity)
$inventory=[ordered]@{captured_at=[DateTime]::UtcNow.ToString('o');os=Get-CimInstance Win32_OperatingSystem | Select-Object Caption,Version,BuildNumber,OSArchitecture;gpu=@(Get-CimInstance Win32_VideoController | Select-Object Name,DriverVersion,DriverDate,AdapterCompatibility,PNPDeviceID);administrator_token=$principal.IsInRole([Security.Principal.WindowsBuiltInRole]::Administrator)}
$inventory | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10 | Set-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $outDir 'target-inventory.json') -Encoding utf8
$results=@()
foreach($backend in @('mf','amf')) {
  $name=if($backend -eq 'mf'){'windows-hevc-direction-probe.exe'}else{'windows-amf-hevc-direction-probe.exe'}
  $exe=Join-Path $toolDir $name
  $hash=(Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 -LiteralPath $exe).Hash.ToLowerInvariant()
  foreach($profile in @('main8','main10')) { foreach($direction in @('encode','decode')) {
    $label=$backend+'-'+$profile+'-'+$direction
    $args=@($direction,$profile,'1920','1080','60','8000')
    $info=New-Object Diagnostics.ProcessStartInfo
    $info.FileName=$exe
    $info.Arguments=$args -join ' '
    $info.WorkingDirectory=$toolDir
    $info.UseShellExecute=$false
    $info.CreateNoWindow=$true
    $info.RedirectStandardOutput=$true
    $info.RedirectStandardError=$true
    $start=[DateTime]::UtcNow.ToString('o')
    $sw=[Diagnostics.Stopwatch]::StartNew()
    $proc=[Diagnostics.Process]::Start($info)
    $stdout=$proc.StandardOutput.ReadToEndAsync()
    $stderr=$proc.StandardError.ReadToEndAsync()
    $proc.WaitForExit()
    $sw.Stop()
    [IO.File]::WriteAllText((Join-Path $outDir ($label+'.stdout.log')),$stdout.Result,(New-Object Text.UTF8Encoding($false)))
    [IO.File]::WriteAllText((Join-Path $outDir ($label+'.stderr.log')),$stderr.Result,(New-Object Text.UTF8Encoding($false)))
    $row=[ordered]@{backend=$backend;profile=$profile;direction=$direction;executable=$exe;executable_sha256=$hash;arguments=$args;started_at=$start;duration_ms=$sw.Elapsed.TotalMilliseconds;exit_code=$proc.ExitCode;stdout=$label+'.stdout.log';stderr=$label+'.stderr.log'}
    $results+= $row
    $results | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10 | Set-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $outDir 'target-results.json') -Encoding utf8
    Write-Output ($label+' exit='+$proc.ExitCode+' duration_ms='+$sw.Elapsed.TotalMilliseconds)
  }}
}

$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
$toolDir='C:\Users\Zhang\.codex\tmp\nestlink-baseline\58e3948-target-tools\artifact-13211108772-verified'
$outDir='C:\Users\Zhang\.codex\tmp\nestlink-resume-20261103\target-58e3948'
$identity=[Security.Principal.WindowsIdentity]::GetCurrent()
$principal=[Security.Principal.WindowsPrincipal]::new($identity)
if($principal.IsInRole([Security.Principal.WindowsBuiltInRole]::Administrator) -or -not [Environment]::UserInteractive){throw 'Original target requires an ordinary interactive token'}
$exe=Join-Path $toolDir 'windows-hdr10-direction-probe.exe'
$receipt=Get-Content (Join-Path $toolDir 'receipt.json') -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json
$declared=@($receipt.files|Where-Object path -eq 'windows-hdr10-direction-probe.exe')
$hash=(Get-FileHash $exe -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLowerInvariant()
if($declared.Count -ne 1 -or $hash -ne $declared[0].sha256 -or (Get-Item $exe).Length -ne $declared[0].bytes){throw 'HDR executable differs from the verified Actions payload'}
$results=@()
foreach($backend in @('system-mf','amd-amf')) { foreach($direction in @('encode','decode')) {
    $label='hdr10-'+$backend+'-'+$direction
    $arguments=@($direction,$backend,'1920','1080','60','8000')
    $info=[Diagnostics.ProcessStartInfo]::new()
    $info.FileName=$exe
    foreach($argument in $arguments){$info.ArgumentList.Add($argument)}
    $info.WorkingDirectory=$toolDir
    $info.UseShellExecute=$false
    $info.CreateNoWindow=$true
    $info.RedirectStandardOutput=$true
    $info.RedirectStandardError=$true
    $start=[DateTime]::UtcNow.ToString('o')
    $sw=[Diagnostics.Stopwatch]::StartNew()
    $proc=[Diagnostics.Process]::Start($info)
    $stdout=$proc.StandardOutput.ReadToEndAsync()
    $stderr=$proc.StandardError.ReadToEndAsync()
    $proc.WaitForExit()
    $sw.Stop()
    [IO.File]::WriteAllText((Join-Path $outDir ($label+'.stdout.log')),$stdout.Result,[Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false))
    [IO.File]::WriteAllText((Join-Path $outDir ($label+'.stderr.log')),$stderr.Result,[Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false))
    $results+=[ordered]@{backend=$backend;profile='hdr10';direction=$direction;source_revision=$receipt.source_revision;executable=$exe;executable_sha256=$hash;arguments=$arguments;started_at=$start;duration_ms=$sw.Elapsed.TotalMilliseconds;exit_code=$proc.ExitCode;stdout=$label+'.stdout.log';stderr=$label+'.stderr.log'}
    [IO.File]::WriteAllText((Join-Path $outDir 'target-hdr10-results.json'),($results|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10)+"`n",[Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false))
    Write-Output ($label+' exit='+$proc.ExitCode+' duration_ms='+$sw.Elapsed.TotalMilliseconds)
}}
